svg.title: iOS · Photo editor · Regions page · Masks section · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (stackedBody, touchChrome, markedRailTabs, masksTab(tabbed: true)) hosting App/Overlay/OverlayMasksPanel.swift in its PHONE form (tabbed — RegionsSection, sectionBar, maskToolbar, deckCard, customMasksCard) with App/EditorControls/EditorTabPill.swift in the top row. Code first (Steven's consistency audit, 2026-10-16), drawn from the iPhone 16 Pro simulator the same afternoon (regions-masks4.png: LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=0633D6E7…:regions on the tram library's "Photo 13. 9. at 13:45", a 3:4 still with ONE register shape; measured at 402 pt wide and carried to this 393 pt canvas — trailing positions sit 9 pt further left here). THE PAGE: the Masks tab is called REGIONS since 2026-10-16 — it holds the project's masks AND its shapes, and "Masks" named half of it; the RailTab case and every hook keep the old word (LL_RAIL=masks, LL_ITEM=<id>:masks — `regions` answers too). THE PILL: `Regions*` — the trailing asterisk says the project holds a region of its own (RailTab.label(marked:) over PhotoViewerView.markedRailTabs: a drawn mask, a custom mask file or a register shape; Sky and Land are the analysis's, a grade inside a mask the Editor page's); with none the seat reads Regions. Seats content-sized (label + 24, 2 pt apart, 3 pt inset, right edge 377): Editor 58.8 · Text 50 · Regions* 77.7 (Regions 72.0), the selected seat amber with a black label. TOP ROW = the Editor page's (touchChrome: back disc, ⓘ disc, the pill), the same on every page since this date, so a tap on Text or Regions moves the highlight and nothing else; the RailTabBar that sat under the grabber on the Text / Frames / Masks pages is gone on iOS. A SWIPE on the picture pages to the next or previous project ON THIS PAGE (allowsPaging on every page; EditorPagingState.page carries it; a mask handle's own drag still wins). LAYOUT (stackedBody): the picture 393×524 (3:4) pinned under the status bar, the chrome row floating over its head, the ⤢ 1:1 control bottom-trailing 12 pt in; the MediaResizeHandle row (28 pt, the 36×5 grabber white 35 %); then the scroll view, 16 pt sides, 14 pt top. THE SECTION SWITCHER (sectionBar, NEW): Masks | Shapes in the rail tab bar's dress — a 36 pt #1C1C1E capsule track, two equal seats (176.5) 2 pt apart, the chosen one amber with a black 13/600 label, the other's label amber — where the RailTabBar used to be; the choice is remembered in @AppStorage("editor.regionsSection") across projects and launches ("whatever they did last remains open"); a tap clears the other section's selection and armed tool (a mask's handles left under the Shapes section would take the next drag), and a selection or tool made from outside the page — the Editor tab's Masks card's Manage › / New Linear mask…, "Use as mask", a hook — lands on the section that owns it (followSelection). The Mac and the iPad rail keep the one stack. MASKS SECTION: the mask toolbar (maskToolbar: Linear · Radial · ＋ Custom… — three equal 115 pt buttons, 8 pt gaps, 30 pt; Linear/Radial on #1C1C1E with amber 12.5/600 labels, armed = amber fill; ＋ Custom… dashed amber-45 % on amber-4 %), then the MASKS deck card (14 pt padding, radius 12, #1C1C1E): "Masks" 13/600 white 55 % with the mono count "2 masks", a 3-column grid of 4:3 tiles (105.7×79.25, 8 pt columns, 10 pt rows) — Sky and Land with their AUTO chip, drawn DIMMED TO 40 % as captured (the simulator has no segmentation model; installed, they are full strength and tappable), the Sky tile's cached horizon — the card runs under the fold (the legend line and the CUSTOM MASKS card below it scroll into view; desc-only). SHAPES SECTION: project-photo.viewer.regions.shapes.portrait.svg. NOT DRAWN: a selected mask's detail card, an armed tool's HUD pill, the magenta Show mask tint, the model-missing note in the Custom Masks card. Hooks: LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid|latest>:regions (or :masks), LL_REGIONS=masks|shapes[@<seconds>] presses the switcher through the real path (DEBUG, 2026-10-16), LL_MASKTOOL=linear|radial, LL_SHAPETOOL=ellipse|rect|square.
